primary.contract: Data abort returns to the faulting instruction address; host emulation must obtain load data before committing its PC.

proposed_changes: Stage an absolute next PC for newly trapped native scalar MMIO reads without advancing current PC.
On complete input, write the GPR then the absolute next PC; repeated SDK partial-failure retries write the same PC rather than incrementing again.
Persist absolute next PC in a new private format version. Explicitly decode current V4 records with no deferred PC, preserving their historically advanced frontier; no silent V4 reinterpretation.
Keep incomplete and failed replies staged; never perform a second device read after obtaining a full value.
Validate PC/alignment/reply-state relationships; retain wire byte limits and reject unknown versions.

assumption_register.assumption: The admitted native AArch64 scalar load instruction occupies four bytes.
assumption_register.basis: AArch64 native profile; SDK exception IL and independent LLVM encoding.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Stage wrapping PC+4 once at trap.
assumption_register.stress_test: Invalid IL; zero register; all widths/sign variants; 64-bit wrapping boundary.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Non-four-byte native trap is admitted or PC advances with incomplete input.
assumption_register.qualification: Four-byte native instruction contract and wrapping frontier checked in complete current root/policy binaries; real hardware read keeps PC until full input. Invalid SDK-supplied IL is guarded in source, not physically fault-injected.

assumption_register.assumption: A failed SDK register/PC setter can have changed its destination before returning an error.
assumption_register.basis: Defensive SDK-failure boundary; no no-mutation guarantee assumed.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Use absolute idempotent writeback addresses, retain complete input across retry and private file continuation.
assumption_register.stress_test: GPR and PC errors before/after mutation; repeated identical completion; staged reply checkpoint.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Retry increments PC twice, re-reads a device, or clears pending data after an error.
assumption_register.qualification: Complete policy cases cover GPR/PC failures before/after mutation and absolute retry. Actual saved-reply native file continuation passed. Physical after-mutation SDK failure injection remains unknown.

assumption_register.assumption: V4 native private records encode an already-advanced pending-read PC.
assumption_register.basis: Actual pre-fix native capture and arm64_context_format.rs V4 schema.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Explicit compatibility migration, preserving old PC and avoiding a second advancement.
assumption_register.stress_test: V4 pending read/reply/error/terminal variants, unknown tag and trailing/truncated bytes.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A V4 pending reply advances its imported PC again or changes an unrelated private field.
assumption_register.qualification: Four exact old-producer synthetic wire fixtures decode in current complete root tests. Two direct hardware CPU-record imports preserve ordinary and explicit legacy PC continuation; no whole legacy V4 VM/file claim.

assumption_register.assumption: Host fixture code writes are published after modification and before native entry.
assumption_register.basis: Apple OSCacheControl.h and the direct SDK cache-control experiment.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Actual installed instruction and pending register/PC assertions in native startup/file continuations.
assumption_register.stress_test: 1/2/4-CPU startup rewrites, reversed creation, HVC/SMC convention changes and post-I/O continuations.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A native case reports a different instruction frontier or destination after explicitly publishing the expected installed bytes.
assumption_register.qualification: Ordering and complete current native-module assertions checked on the recorded Apple host; no general production code-cache qualification.
